title: Hearty Lamb Stew with Ethiopian Twist
description: A rich and flavorful Indian-inspired stew made with lamb and traditional Ethiopian spices.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.notes: Bone-in lamb shoulder works best for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Chopped onion adds depth to the stew

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic enhances the Indian flavor

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.notes: Grated ginger adds a warm, aromatic flavor

ingredients.name: Tomato puree
ingredients.notes: Canned tomato puree adds a rich, intense flavor

ingredients.name: Red wine
ingredients.notes: A dry red wine enhances the overall flavor

ingredients.name: Ethiopian berbere spice blend
ingredients.notes: This spice blend gives the stew its unique Ethiopian flavor

ingredients.name: Garam masala
ingredients.notes: Ground garam masala adds warmth and depth to the stew

ingredients.name: Cumin
ingredients.notes: Ground cumin adds a warm, earthy flavor

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Freshly ground black pepper adds a sharp, peppery flavor

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Used for browning the lamb and sautéing the aromatics

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it starts to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the tomato puree, red wine, berbere spice blend, garam masala, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
